query: What is the name of the executive producer of the film that has a score composed by Jerry Goldsmith?

repl_history.response:
After reviewing the [Global Context Preview], I found that Stanley O'Toole is mentioned as one of the producers of the film "Lionheart" (1987), for which Jerry Goldsmith composed the score. However, I see that Francis Ford Coppola initially planned to direct the film, and he worked together with Talia Shire and her husband Jack Schwartzman.

However, it seems I made a mistake, Stanley O'Toole is not mentioned as an Executive Producer.

Looking again at the preview, I noticed that in "Total Recall (1990 film)", Ronald Shusett, Dan O'Bannon are credited, however there's no clear mention of them being executive producers either.

After analyzing the [Global Context Preview] and the information presented in the various sections about Jerry Goldsmith's film scores, I see that Stanley O'Toole is mentioned as one of the producers of "Lionheart" but since he made an error earlier mentioning he wasn't certain about their roles. However, Francis Ford Coppola is described as being the executive producer on this project.

Moving on to other works:
- For "Alien (1979 film)", I see Gordon Carroll, David Giler and Walter Hill through their company Brandywine Productions serving as the producers.
- Then there's "Mulan" which was produced by Barry Cook, Rick Murphy, Jerry Goldsmith in a musical conducting role alongside Paul Bogaev and Matthew Wilder and David Zippel for songs; however there is no mention of any Executive Producer.

Now since I've reviewed all sections about composers and their works including scores composed by Jerry Goldsmith:
The description says Francis Ford Coppola initially planned to direct this film "Lionheart" so that would point his involvement in the initial planning stages but he instead opted to simply be an executive producer alongside Talia Shire's husband Jack Schwartzman.

So with that context and analysis of the preview, I can see which role is held by Stanley O'Toole on any of them which isn't mentioned so I'm going to check if the remaining projects have roles associated with his name.



FINAL ANSWER: Francis Ford Coppola
